title: Guest checkout form with full customer details and inline admin order management

requirements.text: Extend the backend Order type to include guest customer details: fullName (Text), email (Text), phone (Text), street (Text), city (Text), postalCode (Text), and orderNotes (Text, optional). Update all order creation endpoints (createOrder, or equivalent) to accept and persist these fields. Ensure existing orders remain intact via migration.

quotes: name, email, phone number, delivery address — are there other fields also whichbever according to you.
show a list of all orders with customer details inline

acceptanceCriteria: Order records in stable storage include fullName, email, phone, street, city, postalCode, and orderNotes fields.
createOrder (or equivalent) accepts the new customer detail fields and persists them.
Existing orders are not lost after upgrade; migration preserves all prior fields.
Querying an order returns all new customer detail fields.

requirements.text: Update the Cart/Checkout page (frontend/src/pages/Cart.tsx and/or frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx) to collect the following fields from all customers (including guests, with no login required): Full Name, Email Address, Phone Number, Delivery Street Address, City, Postal Code, and Order Notes (optional). Validate required fields before allowing order submission. Pass all collected fields to the order creation call.

quotes: name, email, phone number, delivery address — are there other fields also whichbever according to you.
Checkout Form (for all customers, including guests)

acceptanceCriteria: The checkout form displays fields for Full Name, Email, Phone, Street, City, Postal Code, and Order Notes.
Required fields (Name, Email, Phone, Street, City, Postal Code) show validation errors if left empty on submit.
A guest (unauthenticated) user can complete checkout without logging in.
All form values are passed to the backend order creation call.
Order Notes field is optional and clearly labelled as such.

requirements.text: Redesign the Admin Orders page (frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrders.tsx) to display full customer details inline within each order row/card without requiring a modal click. Each order entry must show: Order ID, Date & Time, Customer Full Name, Email, Phone, Full Delivery Address (street, city, postal code), Ordered Items with quantities and unit prices, Order Total, and Order Status. Use an expandable row or an always-visible detail section beneath each row in the list.

quotes: In the admin panel I don't see user detail likenname address order id. Even if the customer is not register.
show a list of all orders with customer details inline
Order ID, Date & time, Customer name, email, phone, delivery address, Items ordered with quantities and prices, Order total, Order status

acceptanceCriteria: The Admin Orders list shows Order ID, Date & Time, Customer Name, Email, Phone, and full delivery address for every order.
Each order in the list shows the ordered items with their quantities and individual prices.
The order total and current status (Pending, Processing, Delivered, etc.) are visible per order.
Guest orders (no registered account) display all collected customer details just as registered-user orders do.
No modal click is required to see the core customer details — they are visible inline or in an always-visible expanded section.

requirements.text: Update the OrderDetailModal (frontend/src/components/admin/OrderDetailModal.tsx) to display all new customer fields (fullName, email, phone, street, city, postalCode, orderNotes) when an admin opens an individual order, so the full delivery address and contact info are shown there as well.

quotes: I don't see user detail likenname address order id
Customer name, email, phone, delivery address

acceptanceCriteria: OrderDetailModal renders fullName, email, phone, street, city, postalCode, and orderNotes from the order record.
If orderNotes is empty, that field is hidden or labelled 'None'.
All fields are displayed for both guest and registered-user orders.

constraints: All Motoko logic must remain in backend/main.mo (single-actor architecture).
Guest checkout must not require Internet Identity login.
Do not remove or break existing Razorpay payment integration.
Immutable frontend paths (hooks, main.tsx, ui components) must not be modified.
Existing order data must be preserved via migration.mo when upgrading stable storage.
nonGoals: Adding a new user registration or login flow.
Sending confirmation emails or SMS to customers.
Building a separate guest account system.
Changing the product management or settings admin pages.
Adding real-time order updates or WebSocket functionality.
